name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is an advanced-stage developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos silver-gold project in the Salta province of Argentina. Diablillos is one of Argentina's largest undeveloped precious metals projects, with a completed Definitive Feasibility Study reporting a CAD$4.2B after-tax NPV5% and 42% IRR with a 1.7-year payback. The project has received approval under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI) and the company is advancing toward construction.
